claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Scopolamine-N-oxide is a quaternary, permanently charged muscarinic antagonist with poor membrane permeability and no documented cytotoxic pharmacophore, so at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive rather than to kill cells.
